title: Spicy Thai Koi Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy stir fry made with fresh koi, noodles, and a variety of Thai spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced koi and cook until browned and cooked through, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the koi from the wok and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the wok.
Add the Thai green curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the noodles to the wok and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to brown.
Add the chopped pak leafy greens, Thai red pepper flakes, Thai fish sauce, and Thai palm sugar to the wok.
Stir-fry everything together for 2-3 minutes, until the greens are wilted and the noodles are cooked through.
Return the cooked koi to the wok and stir-fry for another minute.
